purpose: T71 regime-gated conditional policy replay. Global ridge is temporally unstable across folds (fold1 reverses), so test the sparse conditional alternative: long only inside the joint high-funding x high-basis (/ high-rv) regime found in T66/T70. Honest net replay on real cohort, NOT a tradability claim.

strategy.tri_gate: funding_pct>=0.80 AND basis_pct>=0.66 AND rv_pct>=0.66 -> long 5 bars
strategy.double_gate: funding_pct>=0.80 AND basis_pct>=0.66 -> long 5 bars (vol-gate ablation)
strategy.percentiles: trailing-180 mid-rank per feature per asset, PIT-safe

costs.funding_accrual: direction * last_funding_rate * (24/funding_interval_hours) per held day — approximation flagged; fallback 8h -> 3/day

expected_limitation: gate trades are sparse by construction; fold-level n will be tiny; per-trade advantage does not imply deployable edge
